answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 12 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 190 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The zephyr of the curve is the gate, the haven of the reset is the trap, and the quartz of the history is the asset no farm can print.
